description: Calendar chart point equals the day's earnedIncome for every W2 day. Uses the W2 inputs (Mon Sep 28 .. Fri Oct 2 2026, 48h at 283c, Monday-start workweek, 40h/1.5x). The chart may never compute its own number: each point is the sum of that day's ShiftValuation components, so the Thursday point carries its 849c overtime share and the Friday point is all overtime.
notes: Plan Design 1 worked example B, restated per day so the Calendar chart can be checked against it (plan 'Metric registry' + 'PR 1': M1 chart point == day total; Design 2 'Facts structs -> thin adapters': Calendar dailyTotals move to the engine). Arithmetic in 1/6000 cent, rate 283c, threshold 2400 min, multiplier 150, roundCents(x) = (2x+6000)/12000 integer division, threshold split chronologically, cumulative rounding per stream. REGULAR stream: Mon 615m -> cum 615, exact 283*615*100 = 17,404,500, roundCents = (34,809,000+6,000)/12,000 = 2901 (2901.25 truncates) -> Mon 2901. Tue 585m -> cum 1200, exact 33,960,000, roundCents = 67,926,000/12,000 = 5660 (5660.5 truncates) -> Tue 5660-2901 = 2759. Wed 630m -> cum 1830, exact 51,789,000, roundCents = 103,584,000/12,000 = 8632 -> Wed 8632-5660 = 2972. Thu 690m -> regular = clamp(2400-1830, 0, 690) = 570, cum 2400, exact 67,920,000, roundCents = 135,846,000/12,000 = 11320 (11320.5 truncates) -> Thu regular 11320-8632 = 2688. Fri 360m -> regular 0 (threshold already reached), cum stays 2400 -> Fri regular 0. Regular sum 2901+2759+2972+2688+0 = 11320 = 40h*283c. OVERTIME stream: Thu 120m -> exact 283*120*150 = 5,094,000, roundCents = 10,194,000/12,000 = 849 -> Thu OT 849. Fri 360m -> cum 480, exact 283*480*150 = 20,376,000, roundCents = 40,758,000/12,000 = 3396 (3396.5 truncates) -> Fri OT 3396-849 = 2547. OT sum 3396 = 8h*424.5c. DAY earnedIncome = cash+credit+gratuity-tipOut+regular+overtime with all tips 0: Mon 2901, Tue 2759, Wed 2972, Thu 2688+849 = 3537, Fri 0+2547 = 2547. Chart point for a day is by definition that same sum, so chartPointCents == earnedIncomeCents on every row. MONTHS are sums of per-shift components: Sep (Mon-Wed) 2901+2759+2972 = 8632; Oct (Thu-Fri) 3537+2547 = 6084; range 8632+6084 = 14716. WRONG ANSWERS: today's month-first path restarts the 40h threshold at Oct 1 so Thu is valued regular-only 283*690/60 = 3254.5 -> 3255 and Fri 283*360/60 = 1698; October 3255+1698 = 4953 and range 8632+4953 = 13585, losing $11.31 of overtime (plan example B). Per-shift naive rounding of Thu regular 283*570/60 = 2688.5 -> 2689 gives a Thu point of 2689+849 = 3538, one cent off the cumulative-rounded 2688+849 = 3537 (Design 1 step 5: within 1c but not equal). Tips are 0 by construction of W2, so the discriminating quantities here are the overtime share and the cumulative rounding; the tips leg of chart == day total is covered by the H1 and W1 shapes. asOf 2026-10-02 clamps nothing (all shifts on or before it). Policy effectiveFrom 2026-01-05 is a Monday, satisfying the workweek-start rule for the calendar policy. deviceTimeZone equals the policy zone here; T1 covers the Honolulu case.
